verdict.rationale: Airweave has no native rules engine. It does emit real-time webhooks on organization events such as syncs completing, source connections being created and collections being updated, so an external endpoint can react to them. Its Pipedream integration also exposes actions such as triggering syncs from Pipedream workflows. Event-driven automation is therefore possible, but the rules and actions must live in external tooling. Missing for 10: a native user-defined rule/trigger builder, in-product conditional logic tied to actions, documentation of event-to-action rules inside Airweave, and independent hands-on corroboration.
